<!-- pr-reviewer: e17ccaea9d892429299fc6c32fec4b2a32318a8d -->

Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.

## What looks good

- The change is test and docs only. `git diff origin/main...e17ccaea` touches
  `crates/app/tests/carried_corner_rest.rs` and
  `docs/decisions/1551-corner-sliver-true-rest.md`. No product code changed.
- The decision file states a correct geometric argument. The reviewer recomputed
  it from the fixture numbers. See the check below.
- The probe result is posted on #1551. The issue asked for a probe first. This PR
  gives it, plus the pinning suite.

## Arithmetic check (recomputed independently)

- Tool radius r = 3 mm. The contour offset runs its centre on an arc of radius
  3 mm about each part corner. The tool disc of radius 3 mm about that arc
  sweeps every point within 2 r = 6 mm of the part corner. Correct.
- Stock corner distance: sqrt(5^2 + 5^2) = 7.07 mm > 6 mm. The corner is out of
  reach. Correct.
- Sliver legs: the reach-6 circle meets the side x = 5 at y = sqrt(36 - 25) =
  sqrt(11) = 3.317 mm, so the legs are 5 - sqrt(11) = 1.683 mm. Correct.
- Sliver area: the integral of (5 - sqrt(36 - x^2)) from x = sqrt(11) to x = 5
  is 1.227 mm^2. Correct.
- The reach test in the suite uses reach = dia = 2 r. That matches the geometry.

## Build and test result

- Built on the self-hosted runner: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43590224763
  (main sha `57bdcf650`, trial merge clean, head check passed).
- Quick gate on the merged tree: 1 step, `app:carried_corner_rest`, ok, 0 failed.
  The runner planned the whole new suite because the diff added a new test file.
- Clippy `-p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- No `cfg(windows)` or per-OS pinned values in the diff, so no local re-run owed.

## Law checks

- Test placement: the file imports `incoming_body`, defined in
  `crates/app/src/stock_sim_carry.rs`, and `new_world`, defined in
  `crates/app/src/world.rs`. App is the right crate. The header carries its
  Gate map. The file is 154 lines, under 400. It has a provenance line.
- Test honesty: both tests assert with real numbers. The 6 mm test asserts no
  full-height column inside the swept disc (false rest), no cut column outside
  it (lost material), and a corner area near 4 x 1.227 mm^2. The 8 mm test
  asserts zero full-height brim columns. `expect()` use is test-only, allowed.
- Process: the body ends `Fixes #1551` and carries `Changelog: none`, correct
  for a test-only change. The commit subject `test(sim): ...` is conventional.
  No process file changed, and `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is untouched.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- The area tolerance `4.0 * 2.0 * 1.7 * cell` is wide. The two presence
  asserts carry the pin; the area check only bounds the boundary band that
  straddles the disc edge. The red check in the PR body (8 mm assertions run
  against the 6 mm tool) shows the suite is sensitive. No change asked.

Merging this PR closes #1551 as "not a bug": the corner material is true rest,
and the suite now pins that reading.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
